mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, login_id AS loginId, name, email, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, height_cm AS heightCm, weight_kg AS weightKg, bmi, trait_companion AS traitCompanion, trait_competition AS traitCompetition, trait_place AS traitPlace, trait_intensity AS traitIntensity FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workout_logs ( user_id, sport_id, exercise_date, duration_min, intensity, calories_kcal, memo, source, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, (SELECT sport_id FROM sports WHERE name = #{sportName} LIMIT 1), STR_TO_DATE(#{workoutDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{durationMin}, #{intensity}, #{caloriesBurned}, #{memo}, 'MANUAL', NOW() )

INSERT INTO workout_logs (user_id, sport_id, exercise_date, duration_min, intensity, calories_kcal, memo, source, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, (SELECT sport_id FROM sports WHERE category = 'HOME' LIMIT 1), #{today}, #{durationMin}, #{intensity}, #{caloriesKcal}, #{memo}, 'HOME_WORKOUT', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT w.log_id AS logId, w.user_id AS userId, w.sport_id AS sportId, s.name AS sportName, w.duration_min AS durationMin, w.intensity AS intensity, w.calories_kcal AS caloriesBurned, w.exercise_date AS workoutDate, w.memo AS memo, w.source AS source FROM workout_logs w LEFT JOIN sports s ON w.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} AND w.exercise_date = #{today} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) AS weekCount, IFNULL(SUM(duration_min), 0) AS weekDuration FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date BETWEEN #{monday} AND DATE_ADD(#{monday}, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{monday}, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(#{monday}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(calories_kcal), 0) FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date BETWEEN #{monday} AND DATE_ADD(#{monday}, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
SELECT s.name AS sportName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM workout_logs w JOIN sports s ON w.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY w.sport_id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT s.name AS sportName, w.duration_min AS maxDuration FROM workout_logs w JOIN sports s ON w.sport_id = s.sport_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.duration_min DESC, w.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sport_id AS sportId, name, met_value AS metValue FROM sports WHERE is_active = 1 AND category <> 'HOME' ORDER BY category, sport_id
SELECT DISTINCT exercise_date FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY exercise_date DESC
SELECT DATE_SUB(exercise_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(exercise_date) DAY) AS monday, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workout_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date >= #{from} GROUP BY monday ORDER BY monday
